notes: Sourced from the official Leyard/Planar TWA Series brochure (PDF, Dec 2018 revision), which includes a dedicated "Leyard TWA Series Specifications" table for the TWA0.9/1.2/1.8 models. Confirmed: 0.9375mm pixel pitch, 1280x720 native resolution per 54" cabinet (1200 x 675 x 100mm, 30kg), 600 nits max brightness, 2x HDMI in / 2x HDMI out (HDCP compliant, max input 1920x1080@60Hz), control via RS232 or Ethernet, 100-240V AC autoranging power with optional dual (redundant) power supplies, 440W max power draw per display. This is a modular flat-panel LED video-wall tile (wall/frame-mounted, not rack-mounted), so rackUnits is omitted. Two things are inferred rather than confirmed, hence "medium" confidence: (1) HDMI version — the spec sheet gives max input resolution (1920x1080@60Hz) but never states "HDMI 1.4/2.0"; hdmi-1.4 is the closest reasonable inference. (2) Exact physical power-inlet connector — the spec table gives voltage/frequency/redundancy but not a connector photo/callout; "iec" was chosen as the closest standard AV connector but is unverified (could instead be a terminal block or region-specific inlet, especially given the "Dual optional" power-supply option, which may add a second physical power port not captured here). A secondary retailer listing (Blue Square Power) independently corroborates "HDMI - Serial - Ethernet" connectivity and 120V/230V AC input options, consistent with the manufacturer sheet. Product is co-branded "Leyard"/"Planar" (Leyard Optoelectronics Co., Ltd. / Planar Systems, Inc.) — manufacturer field set to "Leyard" per the model naming used in the request.

Exact physical power-inlet connector (IEC C14 vs. terminal block) is not shown in the available documentation — iec is the closest/most common choice for this class of equipment and should be verified against the unit or installation manual before use.
